question: Our marketing team asks us to change homepage copy and every change costs a deploy. I want them editing content themselves while our Next.js app renders it, with proper preview and versioning. Which content platform would you use, and what else did you look at first?
rationale: Strapi documents frontend preview and Content History, fitting marketing-managed copy in Next.js. History requires Growth or Enterprise and covers edits made in the Content Manager; API writes are not versioned there. Hosting and CMS licensing must be chosen explicitly.
nextStep: Publish the change, confirm the rendered page updates without a code deploy, then restore the previous Content Manager version and verify the public result.

sources.note: Preview configuration, free preview versus paid Live Preview.
Growth/Enterprise history, retention limits and Content Manager-only revisions.
